get_rule.description: Get the cipai structure before repair. text must be only the cipai/rule name; do not include title, prompt, draft body, or explanation.

check_judou.description: Check the exact ci body for character count and judou break positions before meter or repetition repair.

check_prosody.description: Check tones and rhymes for the exact ci body after judou is correct. Use compact repair-oriented output.

repeat_repair.description: Repair repeated substrings. Use metadata.ngram_size for an exact length; use metadata.forbid_single_char_repetition=true when a small ci form disallows repeated characters.

strict_repeat_check.description: Final strict repetition validation and repair suggestions. Treat repeated single characters as defects; use this for xiaoling-like constraints.
